title: Before vs After
subtitle: Raw Course Notes vs Conversational Audio

before.content: Given objective function L(theta) parameterized by weights theta in R^d, gradient descent iteratively computes theta_{t+1} = theta_t - eta * grad_theta L(theta_t). In multi-layer perceptrons, the chain rule of partial differentiation is evaluated recursively from output layer L back to input layer 1 to calculate del L / del w_{ij}^{(l)} = delta_j^{(l)} * a_i^{(l-1)} where delta represents error terms.

after.format: Synthesized Podcast Dialogue (Host A & Host B)

dialogue.speaker: Host A
dialogue.text: Okay, look at this slide. It's a wall of Greek letters—thetas, etas, deltas. What is it actually doing?

dialogue.speaker: Host B
dialogue.text: Picture yourself blindfolded on a foggy hill at night. You want to get to the valley bottom. How do you walk?

dialogue.speaker: Host A
dialogue.text: You feel with your foot for whatever direction slopes downward most steeply.

dialogue.speaker: Host B
dialogue.text: That's gradient descent! And the chain rule? That's just working backward to see which step threw you off balance.

before.content: A server remains in follower state as long as it receives valid RPCs from a leader or candidate. Leaders send periodic heartbeats (AppendEntries RPCs that carry no log entries) to all followers in order to maintain their authority. If a follower receives no communication over electionTimeout, it assumes there is no viable leader and initiates an election by transitioning to candidate state.

after.format: Synthesized Podcast Dialogue (Host A & Host B)

dialogue.speaker: Host A
dialogue.text: So in a cluster, how does everyone know the leader hasn't crashed?

dialogue.speaker: Host B
dialogue.text: The leader literally has to tap every server on the shoulder every 50 milliseconds saying: 'Still here! Still here!'

dialogue.speaker: Host A
dialogue.text: And if it misses a tap?

dialogue.speaker: Host B
dialogue.text: The closest server immediately raises its hand and shouts: 'I'm running for election!'
